/* home-slider.js - legitimate slider used by the theme, about a screen of it */
(function ($) {
  'use strict';
  var Slider = function (el, opts) { this.el = el; this.opts = $.extend({}, Slider.DEFAULTS, opts); this.index = 0; };
  Slider.DEFAULTS = { interval: 5000, pause: 'hover', wrap: true };
  Slider.prototype.cycle = function () { var self = this; this.timer = setInterval(function () { self.next(); }, this.opts.interval); return this; };
  Slider.prototype.next = function () { this.index = (this.index + 1) % this.el.children().length; this.el.children().hide().eq(this.index).fadeIn(); };
  Slider.prototype.prev = function () { this.index = (this.index - 1 + this.el.children().length) % this.el.children().length; this.el.children().hide().eq(this.index).fadeIn(); };
  $.fn.homeSlider = function (opts) { return this.each(function () { var s = new Slider($(this), opts); s.cycle(); }); };
  $(function () { $('.home-slider').homeSlider(); });
})(jQuery);
